title: Warn when the front-door mirror silently drops a venture page
problem: A hub link href="../" or a png asset makes the mirror drop a venture, and regen prints nothing while `--verify` says current.
evidence: platform/pages/README.md: 2 friction reports: python3 prompts/promptctl.py measure (doc friction), 2026-10-15
change: Make regen print each excluded venture with its reason, and fail `--verify` when a venture that has a page is excluded for a fixable reason.
result: too early to call the friction metric (baseline 2 reports/184 records; all 424 records are dated 2026-10-15, so none can be ordered after the fix). Mechanism works: `regen.mjs --verify` on b5b9aaf3c0 exits 0 with 'committed surface is current'.
notes: regen (all modes) now prints each fixable-excluded venture page with its reason; --verify exits 1 when one exists. Currently none, so main stays green. Also regenerated 3 stale artifacts found at baseline.
